messages:
maya: Heads up — installed redwoodctl via Linuxbrew on Ubuntu and hit two annoying DX things in one go. anyone seen odd config precedence + device-code auth failing behind a proxy?

jon: details? what did you install exactly and what's failing on auth?

maya: `brew install redwoodctl` on WSL2. installer dropped binary to `~/.linuxbrew/bin` fine, but config was picked from `/etc/redwoodctl/config.yaml` (system file) instead of my `~/.config/redwoodctl/config.yaml`. also, device-code flow opens browser but the polling to `https://auth.redwood.local/device` immediately 401s when company proxy is set. login hangs.

rafi: ugh. config precedence should prefer user XDG first, then system. we recently added support for `/etc` for distro installs but forgot to keep XDG override.

maya: workaround for me was `export XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$HOME/.config && REDWOODCTL_CONFIG_DIR=$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/redwoodctl` and then `redwoodctl config init` — forcing the user dir. but that's not discoverable.

jon: for the device-code + proxy: are you using `HTTP_PROXY`/`HTTPS_PROXY`? corporate proxies often break the polling by rewriting headers or returning a cached 401.

maya: yes `HTTPS_PROXY` was set by our dev VPN. When I unset it login succeeds.

rafi: two actionable items: 1) change precedence logic so explicit user config (`XDG_CONFIG_HOME` / `~/.config`) overrides `/etc`. 2) detect common proxy-caused 401 during device-poll and show a friendly hint: "If you're behind a proxy/VPN, try unsetting HTTPS_PROXY or use `--auth-method browser`".

jon: i like the hint. also we can add a `--config-path` flag so installers or power users can force a path. low risk.

maya: i'll repro on a fresh WSL image and paste steps. script: ```bash
# repro steps
brew install redwoodctl
unset XDG_CONFIG_HOME
# simulate proxy
export HTTPS_PROXY=http://proxy.corp:3128
redwoodctl login --auth-method device
```

devops-bot: Note: Linuxbrew package maintainer pinged. package PR needs packaging metadata to set default config dir.

rafi: i'll open INF-3050 for config precedence + proxy hint. will include changelog entry and a CLI flag.

ci-bot: Issue created: INF-3050 "redwoodctl: prefer XDG/user config over /etc; surface proxy hint for device-code auth" assigned to @rafi.

jon: small UX nit: maybe detect `HTTPS_PROXY` and proactively warn on first run if using device auth. saves a lot of confused 1:1s.

maya: agreed. thanks — will validate once patch lands. added `repro-wsl-device-proxy.sh` to the ticket.

rafi: patch coming soon. will add unit tests for config lookup order and a tiny e2e for device auth hint.

maya: tagging: `linuxbrew`, `xdg`, `device-code`, `proxy`, `redwoodctl`
